newsitem.title: CANADA: Minorca Resources says doubts Busang report.
newsitem.headline: Minorca Resources says doubts Busang report.

text.p: Minorca Resources Inc said on Friday it doubted the veracity of an Indonesian newspaper report that Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc believed the size of the rich Busang gold deposit had been overstated.

"There was a newspaper article in an Indonesian paper that stated that (Freeport) thought the reserve picture at Busang was less than what has been stated," Minorca vice-president of exploration Rod Thomas said in a telephone interview.
"As far as we know it looks very suspicious. It's not something that a major mining company would do," Thomas said.
Trading in Bre-Minerals Ltd and Minorca has been halted on the Toronto Stock Exchange since early this morning.
Before the halt, Bre-X was off 1.20 at 16.25, while Minorca was down 0.55 at 4.80.

Under a recent agreement, New Orleans-based Freeport-McMoRan holds 15 percent of Busang and the right to mine the deposit. Calgary-based Bre-Minerals Ltd, which discovered the deposit, has 45 percent.
The rest of Busang is owned by the Indonesian government and two Indonesian companies. Toronto-based Minorca has a royalty interest in one of the Indonesian firms.
Freeport officials were unavailable for comment.
